name: Alcazarén (Spain)
description: Square flag horizontally divided red over blue, charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Alcazarén (a castle and a key on red above waves).
history: The arms were approved on 27 September 1991 and published in the Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León of 8 October 1991. The municipal flag, approved on 11 January 1995 and published in the Boletín Oficial del Estado of 7 February 1995, is square, of proportion 1:1, formed of two horizontal stripes of equal width, red above and blue below, with the municipal arms in their colours at the centre.
